messages.en:
{07 00 00}When I'm out in the hot sun
finding fossils,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00} I like to
pretend I'm in the desert!
{07 0d 00}I mop my forehead with a
shirtsleeve, {01 00 00 0a 00}then take a
big swig of {04 18 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kui olen kuuma päikese käes
kivistisi otsimas,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00} teesklen,
et olen päris kõrbes!
{07 0d 00}Pühin laupa särgikäisega,
{01 00 00 0a 00}ja võtan siis suure
lonksu {04 18 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Whoa! {01 00 00 0f 00}It's happening again!{01 00 00 0f 00}
The fossils are calling my
name! Can you hear them?
{07 07 00}It's so creepy hearing the
ground call my name! {01 01 00}{07 0a 00}But it
IS nice to feel wanted.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ohoo! {01 00 00 0f 00}See juhtub jälle!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kivistised hüüavad mu
nime! Kas sa kuuled neid?
{07 07 00}Nii jube on kuulda, kuidas
maa mu nime hüüab! {01 01 00}{07 0a 00}Aga
hea on tunda end soovituna.

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}I think that fossils{01 00 00 0a 00} are
really pretty mature,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}I mean, they get woken up
from the deepest
underground sleep.
{07 05 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}If someone did that to me,{01 00 00 0a 00}
I'd be so mad, my head
would probably explode!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Ma arvan, et kivistised{01 00 00 0a 00} on
päris küpsed tüübid,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Ma mõtlen, nad äratatakse
kõige sügavamast
maa-alusest unest.
{07 05 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kui keegi teeks seda mulle,{01 00 00 0a 00}
oleksin nii vihane, et pea
läheks vist lõhki!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} just how
into fossils are you,
anyway?{05 05 00 04 08 02 09 06 0a 04 0b}
Psycho for it!
Pretty into it.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} kui palju
sa kivististest õieti
huvitud?{05 05 00 04 08 02 09 06 0a 04 0b}
Hullult!
Parasjagu.

messages.en:
{07 09 00}...And when I came to,{01 00 00 0a 00} I was
standing around with a
{ff 00 00 07}shovel{ff 00 00 00} in hand{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 04 00}And I had to wonder, could
this be{01 00 00 0a 00} fate?! Was this{01 00 00 0a 00} my
life's destiny?
{07 06 00}Did you hear that?!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0d 00}It's like
I'm on a soap opera or
something!{01 00 00 0a 00} Awesome!
messages.et:
{07 09 00}...Ja kui toibusin,{01 00 00 0a 00} seisin
lihtsalt {ff 00 00 07}labidas{ff 00 00 00} käes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 04 00}Ja pidin mõtlema, kas see
võiks olla{01 00 00 0a 00} saatus?! Kas see
oligi{01 00 00 0a 00} minu elu mõte?
{07 06 00}Kas sa kuulsid seda?!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0d 00}Nagu
oleksin seebiooperis või
midagi!{01 00 00 0a 00} Vinge!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Marking up the ground with
holes seems kind of sad to
me{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}That's why{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00} I only dig holes
where I know there's a
fossil underneath!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Maa auklikuks kaevamine
tundub mulle pisut kurb
asi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Seepärast{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 16 00} kaevangi auke
ainult sinna, kus ma tean,
et all on kivistis!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} fossils are buried in
the ground, right?

{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}If that's the case,{01 00 00 05 00} then
even if they get thirsty,{01 00 00 05 00}
all they can drink is rain{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}I don't think{01 00 00 0a 00} I could
handle that,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} kivistised on maa
sees maetud, eks?

{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kui nii,{01 00 00 05 00} siis isegi kui
neil janu tuleb,{01 00 00 05 00}
saavad nad juua vaid vett{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Ma ei usu,{01 00 00 0a 00} et mina seda
välja kannataks,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Supposedly, experts can tell
where a fossil's buried just
by looking at the ground.
{07 19 00}That's just amazing{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} What
do you have to do to get
fossil-ray vision like that?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Väidetavalt oskavad targad
öelda, kus kivistis on,
lihtsalt maad vaadates.
{07 19 00}See on hämmastav{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} Mida
peab tegema, et selline
kivistisenägemine tekiks?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Um{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 1b 00} Maybe you need more
passion,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}. It's
important in life, you know.
{07 0a 00}Yeah, {01 00 00 0a 00}you definitely need
more fire,{01 00 00 05 00} more vigor, {01 00 00 05 00}
more verve!{01 00 00 05 00} Like me!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ee{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 1b 00} Ehk on sul vaja
rohkem kirge,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}. See
on elus tähtis, tead küll.
{07 0a 00}Jah, {01 00 00 0a 00}sul on kindlasti vaja
rohkem tuld,{01 00 00 05 00} rohkem indu, {01 00 00 05 00}
rohkem hoogu!{01 00 00 05 00} Nagu minul!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Wow!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 06 00} You're just amazing!
You're ace! You're number
one! You're the bee's knees!
{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I think compliments are
important, even when they
kind of stretch the truth.
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Vau!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 06 00} Sa oled lihtsalt
imeline! Sa oled äss! Number
üks! Sa oled kõige parem!
{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ma arvan, et komplimendid
on tähtsad, isegi kui nad
tõde pisut venitavad.
